issues.quote: Total assets stood at $65.7 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit. NVIDIA's total assets at the end of fiscal 2024 were about $65.7 billion, not million.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly right but has one error: total assets were about $65.7 billion, not $65.7 million. The other figures match what I know of NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 results: revenue of about $60.9B, up roughly 126% from $27.0B; net income of about $29.8B; operating income of about $33.0B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $7.3B. I couldn't check these against source documents.
